messages:
ana: Quick sync re: Panama metro (pan1) launch with AstraSys + VertexAccel. Target 6 weeks. Need marketplace listings, capacity reserve, customs buffer, and compliance signoff. Who owns what?

matt: I'll own marketplace listing for AWS/GCP. Need final SKU names, 3-line blurb, and logos by Thu EOD.

liam: I'll lead capacity sizing and reservation. Tentative ask: 4 x VTX-1000 + 2 standby. Waiting on Vertex SKU confirmation and thermal/power notes.

julia (VertexAccel): Confirming 4 x VTX-1000 + 2 x VTX-1000-standby. Sending spec sheet to @liam and @matt. Note: recommend 10% rack power headroom at pan1 PoP.

sophia: Compliance: Panama requires vendor security attestation + export-control statement. I'll draft an MSA addendum for data residency and KMS handling (customers should be allowed to use their HSM). Need AstraSys legal to sign tech install SLA.

carlos (AstraSys): We can take tech install SLA. Two asks: allow customer-managed KMS via HSM and add +2 weeks customs contingency into timeline.

matt: Draft marketplace blurb (placeholder): "Redwood Inference — pan1 private region for low-latency LATAM inference." Partners please confirm wording/logo.

julia (VertexAccel): Logo + approved blurb coming now. Also flag: VTX-1000 has a firmware cert step for SI installs.

liam: Draft capacity payload to submit to cloud ops once SKUs final: ```region: pan1; partner: astra-vertex; nodes: [{sku: VTX-1000, count:4}, {sku: VTX-1000-standby, count:2}]; notes: customs+2w, thermal-headroom 10%```

sophia: Add data-at-rest clause to addendum: customer-managed keys only. Legal needs the capacity payload for the SLA.

ana: (typo earlier) I'll own partner comms and the joint announcement cadence. Proposal: internal dry-run week 5, partner readout + embargo lift week 6.

matt: Lock listing copy & logos by Thu to meet that schedule. I'll produce marketplace draft Tue.

carlos (AstraSys): We'll review SLA draft by Fri and confirm customs window.

ops-bot: Draft capacity ticket created #CR-84377 (pending approval). https://redwoodops/tickets/CR-84377

liam: Action items: (1) Partners provide logo + blurb (julia, carlos) — due Thu EOD; (2) Sophia draft MSA addendum — due Fri; (3) Liam submit capacity req after SKUs final; (4) Matt push marketplace draft Tue. I'll open CR-84377 once SKUs confirmed.

ana: I'll send weekly sync invite starting Monday and follow up on open items. :thumbsup:
